advice: Usually improves over months to a few years. Methotrexate is an alternative. Avoid strong sun; report eye irritation or lip cracking.

name: Pityriasis rubra pilaris

rx.instr: Women: avoid pregnancy during and for 3 years after stopping acitretin (two contraceptive methods); avoid alcohol during and 2 months after. Check fasting lipids, LFT at baseline and every 4–8 weeks
